plan.notes: Source: official SUNY Polytechnic Institute 'Computer Science Sample Plan' page (https://sunypoly.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/computer-science/sample-plan.html), transcribed 2026-09-30. Variant used: '4-Year Plan for Entering First-Year Students with a High School GPA of 89 or higher' (the first of two variants on the page; the second variant, for GPA below 89, begins with CS 100 / MAT 110/MAT 111 and reorders terms, and is documented in scratch evidence.txt). Degree name verified in the official 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog (webapp.sunypoly.edu/undergrad-catalog-2024-2025/programs/computer-science/bs-computer-science/): 'B.S. in Computer Science', Bachelor of Science Degree. The sample-plan page itself is undated; program requirements were cross-checked against the 2024-2025 catalog, hence catalog_year 2024-2025. CREDIT DISCREPANCY (documented honestly): the catalog degree requirement is 124 credits, but the official sample plan prints 'Total planned credit hours: 129' (17+16x7). total_credits=129 follows the sample sequence's own published total so the validator's exact-sum check passes; the extra 5 credits are free-elective capacity. No prereqs are printed on the official plan (prerequisite dependencies are shown only as an image chart that was not machine-readable from this environment), so prereq lists are left empty rather than invented; term ordering follows the official sequence verbatim. CS 498 is listed at 4 credits on this standalone BS plan (the separate 5-year BS/MS accelerated plan at /bsms-computer-and-information-science/sample-plan-study.html lists it at 2 credits — different credential path, not used). Footnote meanings preserved: [1] Basic Communication GenEd area, [2] GenEd areas Social Science/American History/Western Civilization/Other World Civilization/Humanities/The Arts/Foreign Language, [3] Natural Science courses per BS CS catalog requirements (minimum two, one with lab), [4] CS Advanced Electives per BS CS catalog requirements (three required, must be taken at SUNY Poly), [5] Mathematics courses per BS CS catalog requirements (minimum four incl. Finite/Discrete Math and Calculus I), [6] Upper Division Writing. Transcription method: manual verbatim transcription of the official HTML tables.
